subject.title: Feature: Add per-model generation timeout config

question: Should OpenClaw expose a single canonical per-model total-generation timeout, and should it bound each fallback candidate independently or the entire agent run?
rationale: This is a new compatibility-sensitive configuration contract whose correct default and interaction with existing provider, agent, run, thinking, and fallback limits cannot be inferred safely from source evidence alone.

options.title: Approve a per-model attempt deadline
options.body: Define one canonical per-model setting with documented precedence and a non-resetting deadline for each selected fallback candidate.

options.title: Keep only existing shared limits
options.body: Decline the new model-level surface and direct operators to existing provider or run-level limits, accepting that model-specific budgets remain unavailable.

options.title: Split loop protection from timeout configuration
options.body: Treat repetition detection as separate work and defer the per-model deadline until the timeout contract has an owner-approved design.

recommendation.title: Approve a per-model attempt deadline
recommendation.body: Define one canonical per-model setting with documented precedence and a non-resetting deadline for each selected fallback candidate.

likelyOwner.reason: The existing maintainer review already mapped the configuration and embedded-runner decision surface.
